title: How do I create a new survey?
intent: This article explains how a registered user creates a new survey in EUSurvey.
short_answer: To create a new survey, log in to EUSurvey, navigate to the Forms page, and click 'Create new Survey'. Provide a title, select a main language, and optionally set a shortname (alias). The system creates a new draft survey and opens the survey editor.
prerequisites: The user must be authenticated (registered account or EU Login)
External users may be restricted from creating surveys if isCreateSurveysForExternalsDisabled is set to true
There may be a survey creation limit configured that restricts the number of surveys a user can create in a given time period
procedure: Navigate to the Forms page (My Surveys)
Select the main language for the survey
Optionally enter a shortname/alias for a user-friendly URL
Select the survey type if applicable (Standard, Quiz, Delphi, eVote, Self-Assessment)
The system creates the survey in draft state and opens the editor
important_conditions: The shortname must be unique across all surveys in the system
Special characters &, <, > are not allowed in the survey name
Survey creation limit may restrict the number of surveys per time period
Survey types like Quiz, Delphi, eVote are only available when the corresponding feature flag is enabled
External users may be prevented from creating surveys based on system configuration
troubleshooting: Survey creation limit reached: Contact support or wait for the limit period to reset
Shortname already exists: Choose a different shortname
Cannot create surveys: Check if your account type (external) is restricted
